description:
At first glance, it looks like an ordinary photo.
But look closer, and something that should not be there may be hiding in plain sight.

This is an observation and deduction game where you search photos for anomalies and unnatural details.
Take your time, compare what you see, and pin down the source of the strange feeling.

How to play is simple!
・Study the photo from corner to corner
・Use the prompt as your clue and look for the suspicious spot
・Choose the point you think is the answer

Odd details blended into everyday scenes, things that do not quite add up, and subtle anomalies are waiting to be found.
Some are easy to notice. Others may only stand out after a careful second look.

No complicated rules needed.
It is easy to enjoy in short sessions, whether you want to focus on your own or talk it through with family and friends.

Recommended for players who like:
・Observation puzzles and visual mystery games
・Strange photos and mysterious situations
・Testing deduction, insight, and focus
・Quick brain-training games for spare moments
・Solving little mysteries with family or friends

Do not let the hidden oddities slip past you.
Find every anomaly concealed in the photos.
